% A FAKE paper, made to hold every case of tex/ref-list-same-number next to its control. The e2e
% builds it with the real pdflatex and compares the rule's findings with what TeX's .aux says the
% references print. Not a real paper: real ones rarely contain the bug, this one contains all of it.
\documentclass[conference]{IEEEtran}
% cleveref is not in paperlint's TeX Live; \cref here prints each key of its list through \ref, and
% the .aux that is the oracle is the same either way.
\makeatletter
\newcommand{\cref}[1]{\@for\@key:=#1\do{\ref{\@key}\ }}
\makeatother
% Headings deeper than a \subsection are not numbered: their labels print the subsection's number.
